_doc.how_to_use: Copy to results/m6/p2_spec.json after the W7 stop, delete this _doc object, fill, commit and freeze (evaluate_test.py --look T2 --print-frozen-candidates). T2 also requires a non_look ledger row with look_id W7_stop whose detail JSON has p2_spec_sha256 = the SHA-256 of the committed p2_spec.json. Static checks: check_p2_spec().
_doc.primary: The P2 method entering C4 (P2 - G*) and C5 (P2 - B6).
_doc.methods: Score columns of the test score file: H1, H2 (checked equal to the generic scores) and the P2 method(s).
_doc.scores: test tier only: {path, sha256, layout} as in the P1 spec (line_gene test files under results/m6/tmp/).
_doc.failed_builds: test: null or {path, sha256} (ModelID, method), as in the P1 spec.
_doc.labels / genesets / universes / strata: P2's scalar tAP grid at T2 (subsets of the W1 grid; must include L_prob-or-primary, all, U, none).
_doc.b6: B6 for C5, refitted once on training ∪ validation inside the harness (§4.2) with the W1 feature set and stacking of scripts/w1_b6.py and the hyperparameters frozen by W7 (hgb: max_iter, learning_rate, max_leaf_nodes, early_stopping; random_state = SEEDS[0]).
_doc.bootstrap_method: percentile or bca for C4/C5 (§6.5 skew rule on training).
_doc.fitted_on_labels: Must be false for now: a label-fitted P2 (e.g. B6 + GEM features) needs a refit plug-in on training ∪ validation that is not implemented yet.
